question: Show the city and number of customers for the city with the highest number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_customers DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the city and number of customers for the city with the lowest number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_customers ASC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total number of customers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers;

question: How many different cities have customers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS city_count FROM customers;

question: How many customers are there in each state?
gold_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;

question: How many customers are from Guwahati?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers WHERE city = 'Guwahati';

question: Show the names of customers from Assam.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE state = 'Assam';

question: How many customers signed up after January 1, 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date > '2025-01-01';

question: Show customers who signed up in 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name, signup_date FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2026-01-01' AND signup_date < '2027-01-01' ORDER BY signup_date;

question: How many customers are not from Assam?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers WHERE state <> 'Assam';

question: How many orders are there for each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

question: What is the total quantity sold for each product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

question: What is the total revenue for each product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

question: How many orders were placed on each order date?
gold_sql: SELECT order_date, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;

question: What is the average order quantity for each product?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, AVG(oi.quantity) AS average_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_id;

question: Show each order ID along with the name of the customer who placed it.
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

question: Show each product name and the total quantity sold for that product.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_id;

question: Show the customer name and order status for every order.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.status FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: Show each product category and the number of order items sold from that category.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

question: Show the top 10 customers by total spending, including their names and total spending.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spending FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the total revenue generated by each customer.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: Which customer generated the highest total revenue? Show the customer name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the total number of orders and total spending for each customer.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spending FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.customer_id;

question: Show the total revenue for each customer city.
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY c.city;

question: What are the top 5 products by total revenue? Show the product name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the bottom 5 products by total quantity sold? Show the product name and quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Which product generated the highest revenue? Show the product name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which product was sold in the highest total quantity? Show the product name and quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which customer has placed the most orders? Show the customer name and order count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;
